newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Investigation Bureau starts crackdown on government employees having connections with gangsters.
Provincial councilwoman uses knife to threaten bank manager over compensation case.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Police arrest three men in banknote fraud case.
Taiwan plans to set up special pricing organisation to review state projects.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Banknote fraud case likely to affect government bond market.
Taiwan's top negotiator Koo Chen-fu and Chinese counterpart Tang Shubei both to visit United States in late September.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Some funds face redemption pressure in banknote fraud case.
Economics ministry to maintain loose policy on Taiwan-China trade, but will strictly review investment projects in China.
